subject: How to estimate a zeroinflatedpoisson0 model with spatial structure and linear predictors in the zero-probability component

messages.author: 89213eb72620cb11
messages.subject: How to estimate a zeroinflatedpoisson0 model with spatial structure and linear predictors in the zero-probability component
parts:
Hi! I have one question regarding the estimation of an hurdle poisson model with a spatial structure and linear predictors in the zero-probability component.

I run the examples in the pdf document and everything is more or less clear. The problem is that I'm not sure how to add the spatial structure since the "Poisson" component of the model is just a subset of the original data (i.e. all the y such that y > 0).

I created an example of this problem and my idea for the solution at the following gist: https://gist.github.com/agila5/f69fb7e20772625d22f0ea4702f38706

Could you check if it does make sense?

Thanks
Andrea
